info.description: Registered mail-server admin endpoints (mailcow-type first). Assigning an email to a user in rutba-users provisions the mailbox here automatically. The admin API key is stored encrypted (api_key_enc, AES-256-GCM via MAIL_CRED_KEY) and never returned.

mail_domains.description: Email domains this server hosts, e.g. ["rutba.pk", "trustlist.uk"]. Drives the domain picker when assigning an address.

imap_host.description: Override for provisioned accounts; defaults to the base_url hostname.

smtp_host.description: Override for provisioned accounts; defaults to the base_url hostname.
